verdict.rationale: telli is a voice-agent platform, not a developer tool where telemetry opt-out is typically discussed, but the axis is still fair to ask (does the product track usage, and can a user disable it). The evidence pack (data retention, consent-based recording, etc.) never mentions any telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out mechanism for the product itself. Missing for 10: any documentation of telemetry collection practices or an opt-out setting/toggle.
